concept.name: variable
concept.title: Variables & State
concept.description: Represents a named storage location in memory holding a primitive or reference value that can change during execution.

concept.name: array
concept.title: Arrays & Indexing
concept.description: Represents contiguous memory blocks holding multiple items of identical type, accessed through zero-based indexing.

concept.name: condition
concept.title: Conditional Branching
concept.description: Represents conditional program execution evaluating boolean expressions to select between alternative execution paths.

concept.name: loop
concept.title: Loops & Iteration
concept.description: Represents repeated block execution (for, while, do-while, nested loops) until a termination condition is met.

concept.name: method
concept.title: Methods & Stack Frames
concept.description: Represents named reusable logic blocks with formal parameters, isolated local scopes, and typed return values.

concept.name: recursion
concept.title: Recursion & Call Stack
concept.description: Represents self-invoking functions building an active stack frame hierarchy until reaching a base termination case.

concept.name: object
concept.title: Classes & Objects
concept.description: Represents instance allocation on the heap, constructor initialization, state encapsulation, and instance method invocation.

concept.name: exception
concept.title: Exception Handling
concept.description: Represents runtime anomalies, stack-unwinding, and structured recovery using try, catch, and finally blocks.
